test_title: PYST 11: SSC CGL - English (Held On : 18 April 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.

“Please allow me to leave now,” Ritika said to her teacher.

options.text: Ritika requested my teacher to allow her to leave now.
Ritika requested her teacher to allow her to leave then.
Ritika requested her teacher to allow me to leave now.
Ritika requested her teacher to allow me to leave then.

solution:
The correct answer is** "Ritika requested her teacher to allow her to leave then."**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is in the Direct speech and we need to change this into indirect speech.
 
• The given reported speech is an imperative sentence. Hence, we need to use an infinitive.
 
• Also, the reported verb will be "requested" as the sentence using "please".
 
• The adverb "now" will change into "then"

**So the correct sentence is-** *Ritika requested her teacher to allow her to leave then.*
